extract_fields.GGN: the 13-digit GGN number printed next to the 'GGN' heading on the label
extract_fields.LotNumber: the lot/batch code printed on the label (e.g. 'L 03-04')
extract_fields.LabelColor: the color of the label's printed border/outline frame that runs around its edge -- NOT the color of the paper/background fill behind the text, which is white or cream on every variant. Answer with just the border color, e.g. 'Green', 'Red', 'Purple'

color_tag_checks.name: Label border color matches variety group
